graph_method: Each node aggregates up to five preceding nodes in the chronologically ordered sequence.
limitations: Temporal proximity does not establish cardholder or account relationships.
This is not a reproduction of the paper's GTAN architecture.
Training uses a stratified sample of training transactions; edges connect preceding nodes in that sampled sequence.
Validation metrics are used for checkpoint selection and threshold selection, so they are model-selection metrics, not an unbiased final test estimate.
This experiment is separate from the existing GCN and hybrid inference pipeline.
